M2M

Service accounts authentication & management

Service accounts on AuthNull: What problem do we solve?
AuthNull enables service account authentication and management without reliance on just passwords and SSH keys.

M2M Authentication with policy control
AuthNull facilitates non human, non interactive privilege authentication between machines with policy control and MFA.



How does this work?

01

Setup service account permissions

Setup service account permissions

Setting up service account permissions ensure that service accounts can engage in M2M authentication without having to use passwords or SSH Keys

02

Delegating claims for M2M authentication

Delegation of claims

All credentials must be held by a human identity based wallet, however they can choose to delegate those credentials so that the claims can be accessed without human interaction.

03

Auditing

Authenticate M2M & Monitor Audit Logs

Once service account m2m authentication starts, audit Logs are continously generated. These audit logs can be monitored and captured to understand all m2m activity

FAQS

FAQ's on Service Account

Here are some frequency asked questions for service account authnentication

How does AuthNull's M2M authentication work?

Service accounts authentication works the same way traditional OS authentication works. Except since AuthNull is also a privileged access MFA solution these authentication are routed for verification through AuthNull. What this means is that if clear policies are not created, AuthNull will decline the authentication even though users might have access to necessary claims.

What are the key differentiators of service account features of AuthNull?

AuthNull's service features enable Linux M2M authentication, without just reliance on passwords, secrets or SSH Keys. This means there could be more than one factor available.

Does the Service account depend on a Human wallet?

When authentication policies and claims are created, there is a dependency on the wallet. Once the claims are delegated then there's no dependency on admin wallets.

Are windows service accounts supported?

Support for windows service accounts is coming soon.

Are Active Directory based service accounts supported?

Support for Active Directory based service accounts is coming soon.
